subject.title: fix(reef): bound JSONL store file reads to prevent OOM on oversized audit/replay stores

question: What supported recovery contract should Reef provide when an existing replay ledger exceeds the new 32 MiB cap?
rationale: The correct replay-security posture is fail closed, but choosing whether recovery is a doctor migration, authenticated compaction, retention policy, or an explicitly documented operational procedure determines persistent-state compatibility and cannot be inferred safely from the patch.

options.title: Add a verified recovery path
options.body: Provide a Reef-owned doctor, migration, or compaction operation that preserves the replay-security invariant and prove it against an existing oversized ledger.

options.title: Approve explicit operator remediation
options.body: Accept fail-closed startup or claim errors and document a precise, supported manual procedure with its replay-retention guarantees.

options.title: Defer the cap
options.body: Pause this PR until a durable retention and recovery policy is designed for replay-ledger state.

recommendation.title: Add a verified recovery path
recommendation.body: Provide a Reef-owned doctor, migration, or compaction operation that preserves the replay-security invariant and prove it against an existing oversized ledger.

likelyOwner.reason: This requires a durable channel-state and replay-security product decision rather than a mechanical code adjustment.
